contracts: (Every aggregate invocation has a finite configured time limit and yields a deterministic terminal status; budget exhaustion is unsuccessful.) AND (Every external process has an immutable receipt whose terminal facts deterministically select one classification; timed_out true always yields no admissible success evidence.) AND (The invocation records a finite output limit and terminates with output at or below that limit or a deterministic bounded failure.) AND (The invocation records a finite timeout and reaches a terminal result no later than that timeout, including deterministic timeout-stop status when needed.)
selector_intents: Invoke the aggregate evaluator with a workload that exceeds its configured finite time budget and assert deterministic unsuccessful termination.
Run the existing timeout selector with a process that exceeds its descriptor timeout and assert zero cases plus unsuccessful timeout-no-observation classification.
Run the process-executor output-limit test with an over-limit output fixture; it must fail when no finite output bound is enforced.
Run the process-executor timeout test with a blocking process fixture; it must fail when no finite timeout stops the process.
